title: Simple modules over the superconformal algebra $\mathcal{S}^{\prime}(1,n)$
summary: Let $n\geq 2$, and let $\mathcal{S}(1,n)$ be the Lie superalgebra of zero-superdivergence superderivations of $\mathbb{C}[t^{\pm1}]\otimesΛ(n)$. Its derived algebra $\mathcal{S}^\prime(1,n):=[\mathcal{S}(1,n),\mathcal{S}(1,n)]$ is well known as a superconformal algebra. In this paper, we first study Shen-Larsson modules over $\mathcal{S}^\prime(1,n)$. These modules, introduced by G. Shen and T. A. Larsson, are constructed from modules over the Weyl superalgebra $K_{1,n}$ and the special linear Lie superalgebra $\mathfrak{sl}(1,n)$. We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for the…
